playground.title: Playground

page.gettingStartedDesc: 1. Choose a template or name your workflow  2. Select providers to benchmark  3. Configure tasks (prompt, concurrency, iterations)  4. Click Start to run all tasks sequentially and compare results.

login.changePasswordDesc: You are using the default password. Please set a new password to continue.

validation.passwordLength: Password must be at least 6 characters
validation.passwordSameAsOld: New password must be different from current password

validation.providerNamePattern: 1-64 chars: letters, digits, dash, underscore. No spaces.
validation.modelIdPattern: 1-64 chars: letters, digits, dash, underscore, dot, slash.
validation.displayNamePattern: 1-64 chars: letters, digits, space, dash, underscore, dot.

settings.title: Provider Configurations
settings.description: Configure LLM providers with encrypted API key storage. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and custom endpoints.
settings.leaveEmptyToKeepKey: Leave empty to keep current key
settings.aboutDescription: A real-time benchmarking tool for comparing LLM provider performance across latency, throughput, and cost metrics.

config.goToSettings: Go to Settings to add providers
config.maxTokensTooltip: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in its response
config.concurrencyTooltip: Number of parallel requests sent simultaneously to the API
config.iterationsTooltip: Total number of requests to send during the benchmark
config.warmupRunsTooltip: Requests to send before benchmarking starts, to warm up the API connection and caches
config.intervalTooltip: Delay between consecutive requests in milliseconds
config.outputScopeTooltip: Controls how many documents the model should read and summarize. Fewer docs = shorter output (~500 tokens for 3 docs). Use this to limit output length while keeping the full prompt as input.
config.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one model to benchmark

workflow.stopOnFailureTooltip: Stop the entire workflow when any task fails
workflow.cooldownTooltip: Wait time between tasks (ms). Helps avoid rate limits.
workflow.goToSettings: Go to Settings to add providers
workflow.presetPromptsTooltip: Click a preset to fill the prompt field with a pre-configured test prompt
workflow.testPromptTooltip: The prompt sent to each provider for benchmarking. Use a consistent prompt for fair comparison.
workflow.testPromptPlaceholder: Test prompt — the prompt sent to each provider for benchmarking
workflow.systemPromptTooltip: Optional system prompt to set model behavior context before the test prompt
workflow.systemPromptPlaceholder: Optional system prompt to set behavior context...
workflow.maxTokensTooltip: Maximum number of tokens in the model's response (50–32000)
workflow.concurrencyTooltip: Number of parallel requests per iteration (1–5000). Higher = more load.
workflow.iterationsTooltip: Number of times to repeat the benchmark (1–10M). More iterations = more reliable averages.
workflow.warmupRunsTooltip: Number of warmup requests before measuring (0–5). Discarded from results.
workflow.intervalTooltip: Delay between consecutive requests in ms (0–10000). Helps avoid rate limiting.
workflow.maxQpsTooltip: Global token bucket: max requests per second across all concurrent slots. 0 = unlimited.
workflow.streamingTooltip: Use streaming API for real-time token delivery. Recommended for accuracy.
workflow.cacheHitRateTooltip: Prepends a unique UUID to each request to control prefix-cache hit rate.
workflow.customProvidersTooltip: Override global provider selection for this task. Leave empty to use global providers selected above.
workflow.randomizeIntervalTooltip: Add random jitter to the request interval (±50%) to simulate realistic traffic
workflow.enterName: Enter a workflow name to start

workflowHeader.durationTooltip: Total wall-clock time from first task start to last task completion
workflowHeader.tokensTooltip: Total tokens consumed across all providers and tasks
workflowHeader.bestAvgRtTooltip: Best average response time among all providers
workflowHeader.successRateTooltip: Average success rate across all providers
workflowHeader.estCostTooltip: Estimated total cost based on provider pricing
workflowHeader.totalTsTooltip: Avg total throughput across providers (concurrency × tokens / response time)
workflowHeader.inputTokensTooltip: Total input tokens sent to the API across all requests
workflowHeader.outputTokensTooltip: Total output tokens generated by the model across all requests
workflowHeader.ratioTooltip: Ratio of input tokens to output tokens

workflowResults.p95RtTooltip: 95th percentile response time — 95% of requests complete within this time
workflowResults.ttftTooltip: Time To First Token — how long until the first token arrives (streaming latency)
workflowResults.tpsTooltip: Tokens Per Second — average output speed of a single request
workflowResults.inTsTooltip: Input Throughput — concurrency × avg input tokens per request / avg response time
workflowResults.outTsTooltip: Output Throughput — concurrency × avg output tokens per request / avg response time
workflowResults.totalTsTooltip: Total Throughput — concurrency × avg total tokens per request / avg response time
workflowResults.tokensTooltip: Total tokens consumed across all iterations (input + output)
workflowResults.successTooltip: Percentage of requests that completed successfully without errors

resultsPanel.p95Tooltip: 95th percentile response time — 95% of requests complete within this time
resultsPanel.tokensPerSecTooltip: Tokens Per Second — average output speed of a single request
resultsPanel.sysTpTooltip: System Throughput — total output tokens / wall-clock time, accounting for concurrency
resultsPanel.ttftP50Tooltip: Time To First Token (median) — 50% of requests receive their first token within this time
resultsPanel.ttftP95Tooltip: Time To First Token (95th percentile) — 95% of requests receive their first token within this time
resultsPanel.ttftP99Tooltip: Time To First Token (99th percentile) — 99% of requests receive their first token within this time
resultsPanel.reasoningTooltip: Total reasoning tokens used by the model (for models with chain-of-thought)
resultsPanel.costTooltip: Estimated API cost based on token usage and provider pricing
resultsPanel.successTooltip: Percentage of requests that completed successfully without errors

dashboard.testingProviders: Testing LLM providers. Results will appear in real-time.
dashboard.configureAndStart: Configure test parameters and start a benchmark to compare LLM performance.
dashboard.processing: Processing... Results will appear here when ready.

playground.streamingTooltip: Streaming mode shows text as it arrives. Non-streaming waits for the full response.
playground.thinkingTooltip: Enable extended thinking (Anthropic/OpenAI o-series). Shows the model's reasoning process. Disables system prompt for Anthropic.
playground.promptPlaceholder: Enter your prompt... (paste or drop images here)
playground.noVisionSupport: This model does not support vision / image input
playground.outputScopeTooltip: Controls how many documents the model should read and summarize. Fewer docs = shorter output (~500 tokens for 3 docs). Use this to limit output length while keeping the full prompt as input.
playground.selectPromptModel: Select provider, model, and enter a prompt
playground.noResponseText: No response text (model may use reasoning-only output)
playground.responseTimeTooltip: Total time from request sent to response fully received
playground.firstTokenTooltip: Time To First Token (TTFT) — how long until the first token arrives
playground.tpsTooltip: Tokens Per Second — output speed of this request
playground.tokensTooltip: Input and output token counts for this request

playgroundHistory.noHistory: No history yet. Run a prompt to see it here.

monitor.noProviders: No providers configured. Add providers in Settings to enable monitoring.
monitor.noTargets: No targets selected. Click the gear icon above to select providers and models to monitor.

history.noWorkflowsDesc: Run your first workflow to see results here.

templates.quickBenchmarkDesc: Single-task benchmark — pick providers, set a prompt, and run. The fastest way to compare LLM performance.
templates.latencyProfileDesc: Measure TTFT, TPOT, and full response latency across providers with progressively longer prompts
templates.concurrencyLadderDesc: Ramp concurrency 1→5→10→25→50 to find the performance inflection point
templates.streamingVsBatchDesc: Side-by-side comparison of streaming and non-streaming latency
templates.tokenLengthGradientDesc: Measure throughput at 100/500/2000/8000 token output lengths
templates.providerShowdownDesc: Multi-dimensional comparison: knowledge, code, creativity, analysis, long context, and JSON
templates.costEfficiencyAuditDesc: Compare throughput-per-dollar across short, medium, and heavy workloads
templates.apiReliabilityTestDesc: High concurrency + high iterations to measure timeout rate, error rate, and retry behavior
templates.realWorldSimulationDesc: Mixed prompt types with randomized intervals to simulate actual user traffic
templates.toolCallingStructuredOutputDesc: Test function calling, JSON schema compliance, and structured output capabilities across providers
templates.visionBenchmarkDesc: Test vision/image understanding capabilities — models receive a screenshot and must describe its content
